description: This file defines the 'SubjectsNotModifiableException' class, a custom runtime exception related to policy subject modification issues within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes logic for constructing instances of this exception, handling JSON parsing, and providing builder support.

classes.name: SubjectsNotModifiableException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when policy subjects cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions.

classes.name: SubjectsNotModifiableException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of SubjectsNotModifiableException with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for SubjectsNotModifiableException with specified policy ID and label.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a specific message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated DittoHeaders.
